'''Team Sebulba''' was the name of a [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] team that was formed by the famed [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Sebulba, a [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer pilot]] himself, had since retired from the sport to lead the team. [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]], a [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] pilot who had also served as Sebulba's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] during the [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]] racing season, acted as the primary pilot for the team. During a race on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Beedo destroyed the [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] of [[Clegg Holdfast/Legends|Clegg Holdfast]] under orders from Sebulba. The attack was so intense that Holdfast was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the crash. Later during 22 BBY, Beedo was arrested by a [[Unidentified mercenary (Baroonda)|mercenary]] during the [[Fire Mountain Rally/Legends|Fire Mountain Rally]] race on the planet of [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]], costing the team it's primary pilot.
